title_en: Supplementary Provisions (IV) of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on the Implementation of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China for the Determination of Charges

articles.content_en:
October 14, 2009
Supreme People's Court Supreme People's Procuratorate
Supplementary Provision (IV) on the Determination of Crimes in Implementing the
Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China
Interpretation No. 13 [2009] of the Supreme People's Court
(Adopted at the 1474th Session of the Judicial Committee of the Supreme People's Court on September 21, 2009 and the 20th Session of the 11th Procuratorial Committee of the Supreme People's Procuratorate on September 28, 2009; promulgated by the Announcement of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on October 14, 2009 and shall come into force on October 16, 2009)
In accordance with the provisions of the Criminal Law Amendment (VII) of the People's Republic of China (hereinafter referred to as the "Criminal Law Amendment (VII)"), the Supplementary Provisions on the Determination of Crimes in Implementing the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China of the Supreme People's Court and the Opinions on the Determination of Crimes in Applying the Specific Provisions of the Criminal Law of the Supreme People's Procuratorate are hereby supplemented and amended as follows:
